## Crystal Dragon, Great Wyrm (CR 18)

**XP** 153,600  
 CG Gargantuan dragon (earth)  
 **Init** +3; **Senses** dragon senses, tremorsense 120 ft.; Perception +34; **Aura** frightful presence (360 ft., DC 31), scintillating aura (60 ft., DC 30)  

**Defense**

 **AC** 40, touch 5, flat-footed 40 (-1 Dex, +35 natural, -4 size)  
 **hp** 387 (25d12+225)  
 **Fort** +24, **Ref** +15, **Will** +20  
 **Defensive Abilities** ray reflection; **DR** 20/magic; **Immune** paralysis, sleep, sonic; **SR** 29  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 60 ft., burrow 30 ft., climb 30 ft., fly 250 ft. (clumsy)  
 **Melee** bite +34 (4d6+18/19-20), 2 claws +33 (2d8+12), tail slap +31 (2d8+18), 2 wings +31 (2d6+6)  
 **Space** 20 ft.; **Reach** 15 ft. (20 ft. with bite)  
 **Special Attacks** breath weapon (60-ft. cone, 24d4 sonic, DC 30), crush (4d6+18, DC 30), tail sweep (2d6+18, DC 30)  
 **Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 25th; concentration +34)  

  At will—*[color spray](../../magic/spells/color-spray.md)* (DC 20), *[glitterdust](../../magic/spells/glitterdust.md)* (DC 21), *[rainbow pattern](../../magic/spells/rainbow-pattern.md)* (DC 23)  
 3/day—*[prismatic spray](../../magic/spells/prismatic-spray.md)* (DC 26), *[stone to flesh](../../magic/spells/stone-to-flesh.md)* (DC 25)  
1/day—*[imprisonment](../../magic/spells/imprisonment.md)* (DC 28)  

 **Sorcerer Spells Known** (CL 13th; concentration +22)  

  6th (5/day)—*[chain lightning](../../magic/spells/chain-lightning.md)* (DC 25), *[mislead](../../magic/spells/mislead.md)* (DC 25)  
5th (8/day)—*[teleport](../../magic/spells/teleport.md)*, *[persistent image](../../magic/spells/persistent-image.md)* (DC 24), *wall of force  
*4th (8/day)—*[ball lightning](../../magic/spells/ball-lightning.md)** (DC 23), *[dimension door](../../magic/spells/dimension-door.md)*, *[phantasmal killer](../../magic/spells/phantasmal-killer.md)* (DC 23), *stone shape  
*3rd (8/day)—*[dispel magic](../../magic/spells/dispel-magic.md)*, *[displacement](../../magic/spells/displacement.md)*, *[lightning bolt](../../magic/spells/lightning-bolt.md)* (DC 22), *[major image](../../magic/spells/major-image.md)* (DC 22)  
2nd (8/day)—*[blindness/deafness](../../magic/spells/blindness-deafness.md)* (DC 21), *[hypnotic pattern](../../magic/spells/hypnotic-pattern.md)* (DC 21), *[invisibility](../../magic/spells/invisibility.md)*, *[minor image](../../magic/spells/minor-image.md)* (DC 21), *mirror image  
*1st (9/day)—*[alarm](../../magic/spells/alarm.md)*, *[feather fall](../../magic/spells/feather-fall.md)*, *[magic aura](../../magic/spells/magic-aura.md)*, *[silent image](../../magic/spells/silent-image.md)* (DC 20), *unseen servant  
*0 (at will)—*[acid splash](../../magic/spells/acid-splash.md)*, *[detect magic](../../magic/spells/detect-magic.md)*, *[detect poison](../../magic/spells/detect-poison.md)*, *[ghost sound](../../magic/spells/ghost-sound.md)*, *[mage hand](../../magic/spells/mage-hand.md)*, *[message](../../magic/spells/message.md)*, *[open/close](../../magic/spells/open-close.md)*, *[read magic](../../magic/spells/read-magic.md)*, *[touch of fatigue](../../magic/spells/touch-of-fatigue.md)*  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 35, **Dex** 8, **Con** 27, **Int** 22, **Wis** 23, **Cha** 28  
 **Base Atk** +25; **CMB** +41; **CMD** 50 (54 vs. trip)  
 **Feats** Deceitful, Great Fortitude, Greater Vital Strike, Hover, Improved Critical (bite), Improved Initiative, Improved Vital Strike, Lightning Reflexes, Multiattack, Vital Strike, Weapon Focus (bite), Wingover, [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Toughness.*  
 **Skills** Appraise +34, Bluff +41, Climb +48, Disguise +38, Fly +13, Intimidate +37, Knowledge (dungeoneering, geography) +34, Perception +34, Sense Motive +34, Stealth +15, Survival +34; **Racial Modifiers** +8 Climb  
 **Languages** Common, Draconic, Dwarven, Elven, Orc, Terran, Undercommon  
 **SQ** razor sharp  

**Special Abilities**

 **Razor Sharp (Sp)**  All of a crystal dragon’s natural attacks deal slashing damage.  

 **Ray Reflection (Ex)**  An ancient crystal dragon’s scales reflect ray spells back upon the ray’s source if the ray fails to overcome the dragon’s spell resistance.  

 **Scintillating Aura (Su)**  A great wyrm crystal dragon radiates an aura of scintillating color from its jeweled scales to a radius of 60 feet. All within this area must make a Will save each round to avoid being stunned (if the victim has 15 or fewer Hit Dice) or confused (if the victim has more than 15 Hit Dice) for 1 round. The save DC is equal to the dragon’s breath weapon save DC. This is a mind-affecting effect. The dragon can activate or suppress this aura as a free action.

**Ecology**

**Environment** any underground (Plane of Earth)  
 **Organization** solitary  
 **Treasure** triple
